MetamerismLab.name: MetamerismLab
MetamerismLab.qfep_connection: One pure 580nm wave on the left, a red–green duet on the right, and both resolve to spheres of the exact same yellow. Two different physical events collapse into one percept the eye cannot appeal — color as the retina's lossy compression, metamerism as where the loss shows.

RotatingLaser.name: RotatingLaser
RotatingLaser.qfep_connection: Wave, focus, spread, scan, chaos — a concert rig's whole emotional vocabulary is one MultiMesh and a phase offset per beam, colors rotating on a ten-second timer. Spectacle revealed as cheap: crowd-shaped feelings driven by a pattern enum.

SimultaneousContrast.name: SimultaneousContrast
SimultaneousContrast.qfep_connection: The same 0.5 gray twice, on dark and on light ground, and your visual system refuses to agree with the code. The hidden connector bar is the instrument's cruelty: proof that the difference you see was manufactured by context, never present in the value.

SpectrumVisualizer.capacity: SEE that the color wheel is a perceptual invention — magenta is the seam where the brain closes what physics leaves open
SpectrumVisualizer.description: The visible spectrum bends from a line into a circle. Wavelength-to-color animation phases between linear layout (physics) and circular layout (perception). Magenta dots fill the gap that physics leaves empty — magenta is not a spectral color, it is the brain's invention to close the loop. The color wheel is a lie the brain tells to make the spectrum feel complete.
SpectrumVisualizer.gamwell_reference: Color spaces (RGB, HSV, Lab), perceptual color science
interactions: observe magenta dots appearing in the gap
SpectrumVisualizer.name: SpectrumVisualizer
SpectrumVisualizer.qfep_connection: Lambda between physics and perception — the linear spectrum is pure F (physics, ordered by wavelength). The circular wheel is F + E (perception, with magenta invented to fill the gap). The animation IS the lambda sweep from one to the other.

advancedglitch.description: Interactive colored line visualization and manipulation algorithms
advancedglitch.name: advancedglitch
advancedglitch.qfep_connection: Datamosh, buffer overflow, memory leak — fifteen failure modes each given a pedestal, a name, and an animation schedule. Nothing here is actually broken, which is exactly how corruption becomes a repertoire: glitch as aesthetic requires the removal of loss.

brick_wall_factory.description: grid(width, height) of BoxMesh bricks colored sequentially from a named palette — running bond pattern
brick_wall_factory.name: brick_wall_factory

color_constellation_office.description: Office space with adaptive additive/subtractive constellations
color_constellation_office.name: color_constellation_office

color_mixing.description: Interactive color mixing — combine colors and see the result in different color spaces. Additive (light) vs subtractive (pigment) mixing made visible.
color_mixing.name: Color Mixing
color_mixing.qfep_connection: The two triads don't simulate mixing; they hand the question to the renderer, so CMY darkens through alpha blending while RGB whitens through additive blend mode. Subtraction and addition turn out to be GPU policies, not paint facts.

color_scanner.description: Scans and analyzes color properties of objects and materials. See the numeric values behind what your eyes perceive.
color_scanner.name: Color Scanner

color_space_navigator.description: 3D RGB color cube with HSV cylinder — visualize color as a navigable 3D space. Eight corner spheres mark primary and secondary colors, 500 sample points fill the interior, and a companion HSV cylinder shows the same colors in cylindrical coordinates.
color_space_navigator.name: Color Space Navigator

colorballs.description: N rigid spheres sampled from named color palettes — physics + palette = chromatic rain
colorballs.name: colorballs

coloredlines.description: Interactive colored line visualization and manipulation algorithms
coloredlines.name: Colored Lines

colorsheets.description: Color reference sheets showing systematic color relationships — hue wheels, value scales, saturation gradients. A visual periodic table of color.
colorsheets.name: Color Sheets
colorsheets.qfep_connection: Twenty palettes filed under culture and feeling, sixteen swatches each, captioned and hung as reference. The wall works precisely by suppressing everything about a color that is not its value — mood and heritage normalized into a 4×4 grid.

colortrails.name: colortrails
colortrails.qfep_connection: Each hand writes a spline ribbon that begins dying the moment it exists — trail_lifetime caps the drawing at the last 1.75 seconds of you. Gesture is archived at exactly the rate it is erased, so the only way to keep the trace alive is to keep moving.

dark_side_prism.description: Snell's law visualized — white beam enters prism, refracts into 7-color fan by wavelength-dependent angle
dark_side_prism.name: dark_side_prism

disco_lights.description: Interactive colored line visualization and manipulation algorithms
disco_lights.name: disco_lights
disco_lights.qfep_connection: The geometry is a default sphere; the party is three sine waves at incommensurate frequencies inside the light() pass, red, green, and blue never returning to the same phase together. Disco as a Lissajous figure — spectacle located entirely in the lighting equation.

glitchcolor.description: Color glitch effects — channel shifting, bit corruption, and chromatic aberration. What happens when color data breaks in beautiful ways.
glitchcolor.name: Glitch Color
glitchcolor.qfep_connection: Bit rotation, XOR, quantization — integer operations performed on color, each cube a different violence to the byte. The resulting palette was never chosen by anyone; it is what the number system looks like when you watch it work.

grab_stick.name: grab_stick
grab_stick.qfep_connection: Grab it, point it, and it reads the texture's stored pixel at the hit UV — the asset, not the light. Color here was never a property of surfaces but an image wrapped around geometry, and the stick turns that archival fact into something you hold.

grab_stick_scanner.description: Grabbable stick with a UV-based texture-pixel scanner — samples the hit-point colour from any surface the tip touches, displaying the RGB value live.
grab_stick_scanner.name: grab_stick_scannerk
grab_stick_scanner.qfep_connection: e_entropy: the color thief — a grabbable stick whose tip samples the hit-point pixel of any surface and reports RGB live. Proof that what you see is an agreement: the number changes with the light, the angle, the neighbor.

grabcolorcollection.name: grabcolorcollection
grabcolorcollection.qfep_connection: A palette becomes graspable paper: pull a sheet off the stack and the system names its color by nearest neighbor in the web-color table. Every hue you hold is snapped to the vocabulary a 1990s standards body left behind — continuous color, colonized by a finite lexicon.

gridcolorizer.description: Finds cube meshes in the scene and recolors an 11x11 grid to match the rose vase palette.
gridcolorizer.name: gridcolorizer

k_means_color.description: Extract dominant colors from images using k-means clustering in color space. Machine learning meets aesthetics — the algorithm behind every 'color palette from image' tool.
k_means_color.name: K-Means Color Clustering
k_means_color.qfep_connection: The 'Ada Lovelace portrait' being quantized is itself synthesized — skin tones assigned by distance from center — so k-means clusters a caricature into k representatives of a representation. The double compression is the honest part: every palette-from-image tool does this to its subject.

minimalglitch.description: Minimal glitch aesthetics — subtle data corruption effects that reveal the digital substrate beneath visual representation.
minimalglitch.name: Minimal Glitch
minimalglitch.qfep_connection: Corruption at survivable dosage: fifteen cubes cycling well-behaved functions that impersonate damage, in a demo that ships its own camera and lighting. That total safety is the aesthetic claim — glitch consumed as style only once it is separated from loss.

pillarcolorcollection.description: Spawns a grid of pillar prefabs and cycles palette-driven materials from the shared color catalog.
pillarcolorcollection.name: pillarcolorcollection

shelf.name: shelf
shelf.qfep_connection: Display furniture that holds other artifacts at hand height — the gallery's quiet servant, staging the exhibits without joining them.

shelf_with_stickers.name: shelf_with_stickers
shelf_with_stickers.qfep_connection: A CSG-carved wooden pigeonhole shelf whose compartments hold the project's own grant-application doubts as grabbable papers — 'risk of aestheticizing harm,' 'what if the queer potential gets commodified.' Institutional self-audit turned into furniture you can rummage.

spectrum_forest.description: hue(x) = remap(x, bounds) — 5000 vertical lines colored by x-position across the visible spectrum
spectrum_forest.name: spectrum_forest

strobe_lasers.name: strobe_lasers
strobe_lasers.qfep_connection: Sixteen beams and one visibility bit flipped at 12Hz — the nightclub's oldest trick is a square wave applied to the whole scene at once. The strobe outsources half the animation to the viewer's retina, which insists on continuity the code never renders.

visual_color_mixing.name: visual_color_mixing
visual_color_mixing.qfep_connection: f_order: additive mixing staged live — channels summing to hues before your eyes; RGB shown as the negotiation it is.

color_sets_overview.name: Color Sets Overview
color_sets_overview.description: Interactive color set grabber — explore color families, hue relationships, and palette structures through physical manipulation.

subpixel_display.name: Subpixel Display
subpixel_display.description: Shows how screens create color from RGB subpixels. Three vertical bars (R, G, B) with adjustable intensity via sliders. A combined swatch above shows the mixed color with hex value.

gradient_interpolator.name: Gradient Interpolator
gradient_interpolator.description: Shows gradient interpolation between two colors using RGB and HSV color spaces. 16 cubes display the gradient. Toggle mode to see how the interpolation path changes between color spaces.

banding_gradient.description: The color seam. A smooth gradient quantized to fewer and fewer levels (48 -> 2): the continuum becomes a stack of steps (banding), and the colors between the steps were never sayable. Eat the mushroom and your gamut shrinks.
banding_gradient.name: Banding Gradient
banding_gradient.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for color. Bias is conserved; show the seam.

registry_info.description: Color theory and manipulation artifacts — mixing, scanning, clustering, and glitch aesthetics. Exploring color as data, perception, and creative material.
registry_info.name: color
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Color spaces (RGB, HSV, Lab), perceptual color science, k-means clustering for palette extraction, color mixing models (additive, subtractive)
